name: LaMa remove (in-app)
description: Fills the selection from what surrounds it with LaMa, inside the app: no prompt, no key, no server, offline. For removing objects, people, wires, text or blemishes; it does not invent new things (use a model recipe for that). Download LaMa once in Settings › Helpers (in-app models). The crop goes to the model at 512 × 512, so a large selection comes back softer than the picture around it.
